categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of land titles. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration, ownership transfers, and property rights determinations, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
